title: Formal Analysis of a Fault-Tolerant Extension of the ROSACE Flight Controller
abstract: arXiv:2611.22394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous avionics controllers must satisfy stringent real-time functional and performance require- ments even in the presence of run-time faults. In this paper, we analyze ROSACE, an open-source control engineering benchmark for flight control systems, focusing on its run-time resilience against faults such as sensor noise and sensor failures. We extend the benchmark with an FDIR (Fault Detection, Identification and Recovery) component based on Triple Modular Redundancy.   Our approach builds upon COMPASTA, a tool for Model-Based Design developed on top of the TASTE tool by ESA. COMPASTA enables the modeling and injection of faults into a system's design. Moreover, it implements a simulation-based verification and validation workflow, automating the generation and execution of a set of test cases, based on a user-defined notion of coverage. translated_title: ROSACE飞行控制器容错扩展的形式化分析
translated_abstract: 自主航空电子控制器即使在运行时出现故障的情况下，也必须满足严格的实时功能与性能要求。在本文中，我们分析了ROSACE——一个用于飞行控制系统的开源控制工程基准测试，重点关注其对传感器噪声和传感器故障等运行时故障的抵御能力。我们通过一个基于三模冗余的FDIR（故障检测、识别与恢复）组件对该基准测试进行了扩展。我们的方法建立在COMPASTA之上，这是一个基于欧洲航天局（ESA）TASTE工具开发的模型驱动设计工具。COMPASTA支持对系统设计进行故障建模与故障注入。此外，它实现了基于仿真的验证与确认工作流程，能够依据用户自定义的覆盖标准，自动生成并执行一组测试用例。利用COMPASTA，我们构建了一组形式化模型，包括带故障的模型和带FDIR的模型，并对它们进行形式化分析。
tldr: 本文利用COMPASTA工具为ROSACE飞行控制器基准扩展了基于三模冗余的FDIR容错组件，并通过形式化建模与故障注入对其运行时故障抵御能力进行分析与验证。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the ROSACE flight controller benchmark with a Triple Modular Redundancy-based FDIR component and formally analyzes its run-time fault resilience using the COMPASTA tool with fault injection and automated test generation.
